name: Ea Kar chicken rice
summary: Chicken rice from Ea Kar: rice from Farm 721, cooked in the boiling liquor, tinted with turmeric, and fried in chicken fat. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 names cơm gà chiên as the plate people associate with Ea Kar.
howToEat: The rice has to come from Coffee Farm 721. The chicken is a yard bird from Ea Kar. The rice is cooked in the water the chicken was boiled in, tinted with turmeric, then fried in chicken fat so it is rich and crisp outside without cloying. A price and a street are Check on arrival.
where: Ea Kar district. A street in Ea Kar, and the minutes from Buon Ma Thuot, are Check on arrival.
